messages:
Jordan: Hi team — I'm getting 401 invalid_api_key on the embeddings endpoint after rotating keys.
Jordan: Quick repro: I call the API and get this response: {\"error\":{\"type\":\"invalid_api_key\",\"message\":\"Invalid API key\"}}
Jordan: Example curl I used (copied from our internal README):
```bash
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings\" \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer `sk_prod_ABCdefghijklmno12345`\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Sam (Support): Thanks — two quick things to check: 1) the backticks \` around the key will be sent as part of the header value, and 2) sometimes copy buttons pick up extra markdown.
Sam (Support): Can you try copying the key into a shell variable and printing visible delimiters, e.g.:
```bash
API_KEY='`sk_prod_ABCdefghijklmno12345`'
echo \"|$API_KEY|\"
```
Sam (Support): If you see pipes with backticks inside (|`sk_...`|) that's the cause.
Jordan: Yep, that was it — our internal README showed the key inline as `sk_prod_ABC...` and the copy button grabbed the backticks. Removed them and retried.
Jordan: After removing backticks the same curl (header now: Authorization: Bearer sk_prod_ABCdefghijklmno12345) returns 200 and embeddings payload.
Maya (SRE): Thanks for the quick root cause. Action items: add client-side sanitization to the dashboard copy button to trim surrounding backticks/quotes/whitespace, and update the internal docs to call out not to store keys inside markdown code fences. Filed INT-4312.
deploy-bot: Ticket INT-4312 opened by Maya (SRE).
Sam (Support): For future debugging, if a key still fails, run this to surface non-printable chars:
```bash
printf '%s' \"$API_KEY\" | hexdump -C | sed -n '1,8p'
```
Sam (Support): Closing this thread — glad it was an easy fix. Reopen if it happens again :thumbsup:
